---
title: Table
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Generic function to render any CSV file with smart formatting and sorting
function renderSmartTable(fileAttachment, options = {}) {
  const data = fileAttachment.csv({ typed: true });
  
  return data.then(rows => {
    // Dynamically retrieve column names from the dataset
    const columns = rows.columns || Object.keys(rows[0] || {});
    const format = {};

    // Build smart formatters for all columns dynamically
    for (const col of columns) {
      format[col] = value => {
        if (value == null || value === "") return "";
        
        if (typeof value === "number") {
          // 1. Integer IDs & counts: output raw string without commas (e.g., 1434280)
          if (Number.isInteger(value)) return String(value);
          
          // 2. Scientific notation / extreme floats (|x| < 0.01 or |x| >= 10,000)
          const abs = Math.abs(value);
          if (abs > 0 && (abs < 0.01 || abs >= 1e4)) {
            return value.toExponential();
          }
          
          // 3. Standard decimal numbers
          return String(value);
        }
        
        return String(value);
      };
    }

    return Inputs.table(rows, {
      search: true,
      sort: true,
      rows: 15,
      format,
      ...options
    });
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
renderSmartTable(FileAttachment("../data/bounds.csv"))
```
